title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and comply with face mask usage over time under the influence of peers, observed norms, policies, media, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_network_influence
interactions.description: Persons influence each other's mask attitudes and adoption via network ties using threshold/weighted influence.

interactions.name: location_norm_observation
interactions.description: Persons observe mask-wearing rates at locations and update perceived norms, affecting immediate compliance.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement by authorities and locations affect compliance through penalties and access control.

interactions.name: media_broadcast
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages that modify risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes; misinformation can reduce adoption.

interactions.name: supply_and_purchase
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks subject to prices and availability; supply updates stock and prices over time.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contacts
interactions.description: Persons move along daily schedules (home, work, leisure) creating opportunities for observation, influence, and enforcement.

interactions.name: epidemic_signal_update
interactions.description: Epidemic environment updates prevalence, informing personal risk perception and policy decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of persons wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mask-wearing prevalence observed at different location types (home, workplace, retail, transit, outdoor).

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches the configured target_adoption_rate.

metrics.name: mask_type_distribution
metrics.description: Proportions of cloth, surgical, N95, and none among mask users.

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals complying with mask mandates while mandates are active.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference-in-differences estimate of adoption before vs. after mandate activation.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_by_income
metrics.description: Gini or gap metrics showing disparities in adoption across income groups.

metrics.name: media_exposure_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of pro-mask vs. anti-mask message exposure across the population.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_incidents
metrics.description: Count of days when demand exceeds supply leading to unmet mask purchase attempts.

metrics.name: penalties_assessed
metrics.description: Total number and value of penalties issued for non-compliance.
